label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**4 stars**

I'd use them again, and I'll explain the missing star because it might help if you're trying to decide.

Kilbarrack Van Co moved me from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. It was a two bed flat, though most of the stuff was mine, and the new place is a fourth floor walk-up with no lift, so not a handy job for anyone.

I booked through their website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut, all very straightforward. The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours, and the move took about three and a half. I'd priced around beforehand and every other quote I got was €450 or more, so they were the best value I found by a good distance.

Now the bits that weren't perfect. They were due at 9 and arrived at half 10. In fairness, I got a text at 8:40 saying the job before mine had overrun, so I wasn't left guessing, but I did spend an hour and a half sat on boxes with a cold coffee. It wasn't the end of the world for me because I had the whole day. If you're on a tight handover with a landlord or have to be out by a certain time, it would be a different story, so tell them that when you book and leave yourself a bit of room.

Dessie, who runs it, knocked €40 off the bill afterwards because of the delay. I didn't ask, he just did it, and I ended up paying €300 all in. That's a decent way to handle it.

The other thing is that the base of a brass floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets and arrived without a mark, but the lamp wasn't wrapped. It was my nanny's, so I was a bit gutted. If you've anything you're precious about, point it out before they start loading. And wrap the lamps, lads.

The work itself was great. The couch wouldn't go round the turn on the third floor landing and I was fully ready to live without a couch. The younger lad (Kev, I think) pulled an allen key out of his pocket, had the legs off in a couple of minutes, and it went straight in. Four flights with no lift and not one complaint out of either of them.

They also put my bed back together without being asked, and took away a flat pack shelf I didn't want, which saved me a trip to the recycling centre.

So it's four stars, not five, because of the late start and the lamp. But they were honest about the delay, fair on the price, and they worked hard and used their heads. If you're moving around Dublin and don't have a hard deadline on the day, I'd recommend them, and I'll be ringing Dessie the next time I move.
